item.title: 911 - Season 9B - Review: Why This Show Feels so Different Nowadays, a Trip Down Memory Lane
item.description: Spoilers ahead!It's 2024 on Halloween. Kids are visiting Station 118. The firefighters are all dressed up for the occasion: Hen is a mad scientist, Chimney is Jason Voorhees, Buck is a cowboy, Eddie is a werewolf, and Bobby is a vampire. You probably remember this moment, but if you don't, I'm talking about Masks, the fifth episode of season eight.
